protocol: Exploratory development replication, no threshold optimization or promotion. Two separate16-target panels, shared controls; four outer heldout donors. Per condition training-only attenuation pooled across3 donor guide pairs and both disjoint reference orientations, zero intercept slope clipped[0,1]. Aggregate effects use all available NT controls within each donor/condition; disjoint feature/reference pools are used only for attenuation fitting. This differs from reference-only labels in the earlier donor-state model and is not a direct score comparison. Known-target predictions average aggregate effects across3 training donors. All perturbed genes from BOTH panels excluded in every arm/fit. Fixed all/top128/top512; top panels require equal-donor mean training-control CPM>=1 and rank variance across training target means with gene-name ties. No test-donor fit inputs. Correlation means conditional on validity; alpha0 arms undefined and conditional averages cannot be compared without their counts.
